task.title: Tablet layout, polish and accessibility
task.body:
Make it feel finished enough to judge.

- [ ] Two panes on tablets and foldables
- [ ] Dark mode checked on every screen
- [ ] Screen readers, large text, touch targets of at least 48 points
- [ ] Haptics on moves and syncs; skeletons instead of spinners
- [ ] Cold start and sync times measured (see [[Roadmap#how-the-trial-is-judged]])
- [ ] Third-party notices: libgit2, libssh2, OpenSSL and the kit's dependencies (D1)
